entries.default_message: The request could not be processed.
entries.description: Generic client-side request validation or shape errors.

entries.default_message: The service configuration is invalid.
entries.description: Used when Moira cannot start or serve a request because a configuration value is missing or invalid (for example, telemetry export enabled without an endpoint).

entries.default_message: The request could not be completed because it conflicts with existing state.
entries.description: Used when a resource or operation cannot proceed because of a state conflict.

entries.default_message: A database error occurred.
entries.description: Used when a database operation fails unexpectedly while serving a request.

entries.default_message: The database is temporarily unavailable.
entries.description: Used when Moira cannot reach or use its database, for example when a required database connection is not configured.

entries.default_message: You do not have permission to perform this action.
entries.description: Used when the caller is authenticated but not authorized.

entries.default_message: An outbound HTTP request failed.
entries.description: Used when Moira's own HTTP client fails to complete a request to a dependency, distinct from the more specific upstream provider conditions.

entries.default_message: The idempotent request does not match the previous request for this key.
entries.description: Used when the same idempotency key is reused with incompatible request data.

entries.default_message: An identical request with this Idempotency-Key is already being processed. Retry shortly.
entries.description: Used when a concurrent request holding the same idempotency key has claimed the ledger record but has not finished, or when the advisory lock could not be acquired within the deadline.

entries.default_message: An unexpected error occurred.
entries.description: Used for unclassified server-side failures.

entries.default_message: The pagination cursor is invalid.
entries.description: Used when a list cursor is malformed, tampered with, wrongly formatted, or reused across a different list endpoint.

entries.default_message: The request is invalid.
entries.description: Used when the request cannot be parsed or violates a basic contract rule.

entries.default_message: The requested resource was not found.
entries.description: Used when a requested resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

entries.default_message: The request body exceeds the maximum allowed size.
entries.description: Used when a request body exceeds the configured per-route body limit.

entries.default_message: Too many requests were sent in a short period of time.
entries.description: Used when a caller must back off and retry later.

entries.default_message: A cache service error occurred.
entries.description: Used when a Redis operation fails unexpectedly while serving a request.

entries.default_message: The request timed out before it could be completed.
entries.description: Used when the server-side request timeout elapses before the handler produces a response.

entries.default_message: The stream ended before the response could finish.
entries.description: Used when an SSE or streaming response terminates unexpectedly.

entries.default_message: Authentication is required.
entries.description: Used when the caller is missing valid credentials.

entries.default_message: The upstream service returned an invalid response.
entries.description: Used when a dependency responds with an unexpected payload or status.

entries.default_message: The upstream provider request failed.
entries.description: Used when a call to an upstream provider fails in a way not covered by the more specific upstream_bad_response, upstream_timeout, or upstream_unavailable conditions.

entries.default_message: The upstream service timed out.
entries.description: Used when a dependency fails to respond in time.

entries.default_message: The upstream service is temporarily unavailable.
entries.description: Used when a dependency cannot be reached or is refusing requests.

entries.default_message: The request validation failed.
entries.description: Used when one or more fields fail schema or domain validation.

entries.default_message: Required content is too large to process.
entries.description: Used when mandatory context exceeds the allowed size.

entries.default_message: The conversation is archived.
entries.description: Used when a conversation cannot be modified because it is archived.

entries.default_message: You are not allowed to access this conversation.
entries.description: Used when the caller cannot access the requested conversation.

entries.default_message: The conversation was not found.
entries.description: Used when the requested conversation does not exist or is not visible.

entries.default_message: Conversation policies are disabled.
entries.description: Used when a conversation policy action is not permitted.

entries.default_message: The application already exists.
entries.description: Used when an application key or slug would collide.

entries.default_message: The resource already exists.
entries.description: Used when a unique resource already exists.

entries.default_message: The execution failed.
entries.description: Used when an execution attempt ends in failure.

entries.default_message: An execution is already in progress.
entries.description: Used when a conflicting execution is already running.

entries.default_message: Idempotency keys are not supported for response streams.
entries.description: Used when streaming rejects idempotent replay headers.

entries.default_message: The If-Match header is required for this request.
entries.description: Used when a versioned mutation is called without the If-Match precondition header.

entries.default_message: The image input is too large.
entries.description: Used when an uploaded image exceeds the configured limit.

entries.default_message: The image URL is not allowed.
entries.description: Used when a remote image URL fails policy checks.

entries.default_message: The input is too large.
entries.description: Used when the request body or prompt exceeds the configured limit.

entries.default_message: The execution request is invalid.
entries.description: Used when the request cannot be converted into a valid execution.

entries.default_message: The metadata is invalid.
entries.description: Used when metadata fails validation.

entries.default_message: The JWKS URL was rejected by the server's security policy.
entries.description: Used when a configured JWKS URL fails scheme, address-range, size, content-type, or timeout validation.

entries.default_message: The requested output tokens exceed the allowed limit.
entries.description: Used when the request exceeds the configured output budget.

entries.default_message: Memory consent is required.
entries.description: Used when a memory operation requires consent that is missing.

entries.default_message: Memory is disabled.
entries.description: Used when a memory operation is not allowed by policy.

entries.default_message: The memory item was not found.
entries.description: Used when a memory record does not exist or is not visible.

entries.default_message: The requested memory sensitivity is not allowed.
entries.description: Used when a memory item violates the allowed sensitivity level.

entries.default_message: The message role is invalid.
entries.description: Used when a message role is not accepted by the current endpoint.

entries.default_message: Prometheus metrics are disabled.
entries.description: Used when metrics are requested but disabled.

entries.default_message: The selected model does not support this capability.
entries.description: Used when a model cannot satisfy a requested feature.

entries.default_message: The model was not found.
entries.description: Used when a model is unavailable to the caller.

entries.default_message: The provider URL is not allowed.
entries.description: Used when a provider URL fails SSRF or scheme checks.

entries.default_message: The RAG collection was not found.
entries.description: Used when a RAG collection does not exist or is not visible.

entries.default_message: The RAG document was not found.
entries.description: Used when a RAG document does not exist or is not visible.

entries.default_message: The RAG document could not be parsed.
entries.description: Used when ingestion or parsing fails.

entries.default_message: The RAG document type is not supported.
entries.description: Used when a document type is outside the supported set.

entries.default_message: The resource version does not match.
entries.description: Used when If-Match does not match the stored version.

entries.default_message: The response is already terminal.
entries.description: Used when a response can no longer be modified.

entries.default_message: Responses are disabled for this application.
entries.description: Used when the application policy disables responses.

entries.default_message: The routing policy references a provider model that does not belong to the selected provider.
entries.description: Used when a routing policy create/patch names a provider_model_id that is not owned by the given provider_id.

entries.default_message: The requested scope is invalid.
entries.description: Used when a scope string fails validation.

entries.default_message: Streaming is not supported for this application.
entries.description: Used when streaming is disabled by policy.

entries.default_message: The structured output is invalid.
entries.description: Used when the model output does not match the expected schema.

entries.default_message: Structured output is not supported.
entries.description: Used when structured output is disabled or unavailable.

entries.default_message: The requested scope exceeds the effective system key scope.
entries.description: Used when a system key tries to mint broader scopes.

entries.default_message: Timeout overrides are not allowed.
entries.description: Used when the caller attempts to override an enforced timeout.

entries.default_message: Tools are not allowed for this caller.
entries.description: Used when tool usage is rejected by policy.

entries.default_message: The input type is not supported.
entries.description: Used when a request includes an unsupported input content type.

entries.default_message: The message role is not supported.
entries.description: Used when a request includes an unsupported message role.

entries.default_message: The request option is not supported.
entries.description: Used when a request includes an unsupported option.

entries.default_message: The tool is not supported.
entries.description: Used when a tool declaration is not accepted.

entries.default_message: The request was accepted for processing.
entries.description: Used for success acknowledgements that return before execution completes.

entries.default_message: The response completed successfully.
entries.description: Used when a response finishes successfully.

entries.default_message: The response was saved successfully.
entries.description: Used when a response is written to durable storage.

entries.default_message: Streaming has started.
entries.description: Used when a streaming response is opened successfully.
